name: Athlone
text: Athlone (; Irish: Baile Átha Luain, meaning 'The town of Luan's ford' [ˌbʲlʲɑː ˈl̪ˠuənʲ]) is a town on the border of County Roscommon and County Westmeath, Ireland. It is located on the River Shannon near the southern shore of Lough Ree. It is the second most populous town in the Midlands Region with a population of 22,869 in the 2022 census.

depictions.name: Athlone
depictions.text: Athlone was a ringfort in southeastern Connacht, Ireland. In the 9th century, Athlone was a trading post specialized in trading ale that had been abandoned and taken over by the bandits. Between 879 and 882, jarlskona Eivor Varinsdottir assisted Azar by clearing the ringfort of the bandits and obtaining the deed poll to the site, allowing the re-establishment of the trade post connecting to Dublin.
